verdict.rationale: HelixDB's docs say vector indexes rank node or edge embeddings by distance, and every index definition requires a dimension and a distance metric, so the metric is configurable per index. The llms.txt probe confirms the search is approximate, and graph traversal can pre-filter the candidate set before vector ranking. Missing for 10: the specific supported distance metrics, ANN index type and tuning parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search quality or performance.
